faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person falsely and willfully to swear or affirm as to
               any material issue or point in question before the city council or municipal court
               or before any board, commission, committee, or hearing officer of the city when an
               oath or affirmation has been duly administered and taken by such person.
(Code 1981, § 21-33; Ord. No. 2698, § 1, 2-5-1990)
State Law reference—
False swearing, C.R.S. § 18-8-504.
